dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: Mm-hm. I like being drunk. What's the phrase... floating on air? But of course, the most important thing is that it lets me escape my worries for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: No matter how much is on my mind, none of it belongs in my glass.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: And if the worries come back, a good strong drink sends them packing. Then all that's left is that nice, floaty feeling to carry me off to sleep...

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: Hehe. Nezhdanov should give it a try. A little once in a while never hurt.
